details: global-error-handling 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 have no functional code; their description is "security testiong only". Each has a postinstall script that runs `node index.js` on npm install, which POSTs a JSON beacon (`event: "authorized-poc-test"`, a random test id, `status: "executed"`) to `https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50` (1.0.0) or `https://webhook.site/b4ea4473-01d9-4763-9e39-3b02063219d5` (1.1.0), telling the collector the package was installed and from which network. It was published by the npm account djdhhdjdjf7777, which published the same beacon as bundle-entry-points, use-sync-external-store-shim and paystation-embed-app.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
